item.title: Saudi Arabia Strengthens Strategic Partnership with Egypt Amid Regional Turmoil | Saudi Streets
item.description: In a series of high-level discussions underscoring Egypt's dedication to the stability of the Gulf region, Egypt’s Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty met with Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Secretary-General Jassem Mohammed Al-Budaiwi in Riyadh on Monday, 16 March. Abdelatty emphasized that the security of the Gulf is a “fundamental pillar” of Egypt's own national interests.

item.description: Saudi air defenses intercept ballistic missiles over Riyadh, with debris injuring four residents, as drone and missile attacks continue across the Kingdom amid regional escalation.
